intro.alt: SDG 9: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure - report evidence

intro.text: Sustainable Development Goal 9 (SDG 9) aims to "Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization, and foster innovation." Innovation-driven industrial growth and robust infrastructure are essential for achieving sustainable economic development, technological advancement, employment generation, and improved quality of life. Higher education institutions play a pivotal role in achieving this goal by producing skilled human resources, promoting research and innovation, strengthening industry partnerships, and developing technologies that address societal and industrial challenges.

Kalinga University, located at Kotni, Naya Raipur, Chhattisgarh, is committed to promoting innovation, entrepreneurship, sustainable industrial development, and advanced technological research in alignment with the vision of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, Atmanirbhar Bharat, Make in India, Startup India, and the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. The University has established a vibrant academic and research ecosystem that encourages innovation, interdisciplinary collaboration, technology development, and industry engagement.

The University offers programmes across Engineering, Management, Science, Information Technology, Agriculture, Pharmacy, Allied Health Sciences, Commerce, Law, and other emerging disciplines, integrating theoretical knowledge with practical skills through state-of-the-art laboratories, workshops, Centres of Excellence, industry-sponsored facilities, simulation software, project-based learning, internships, and industrial training. These initiatives equip students with technical competence, problem-solving abilities, and innovation skills required for Industry 4.0 and future technologies.

Kalinga University actively promotes research and innovation through its dedicated research centres, Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF), funded research projects, consultancy services, patent filing, technology development, product design, and interdisciplinary research initiatives. Faculty members and students are encouraged to undertake innovative research addressing challenges in renewable energy, advanced manufacturing, artificial intelligence, smart infrastructure, water resources, healthcare technologies, sustainable materials, environmental protection, and digital transformation. The University also facilitates incubation support, intellectual property development, prototype creation, and commercialization of innovative ideas to promote entrepreneurship and technology transfer.

To strengthen academia-industry collaboration, Kalinga University has established partnerships with leading industries, government organizations, research institutions, and professional bodies. These collaborations facilitate industrial visits, internships, collaborative research projects, expert lectures, skill development programmes, curriculum enrichment, sponsored laboratories, and joint innovation initiatives. Such partnerships ensure that students gain practical exposure while aligning academic programmes with evolving industrial requirements.

The University continuously invests in developing modern academic infrastructure that supports quality education and research. Smart classrooms, advanced laboratories, digital libraries, high-speed internet connectivity, innovation laboratories, fabrication facilities, simulation centres, research instrumentation, renewable energy systems, and environmentally sustainable campus infrastructure provide an enabling environment for learning, experimentation, and innovation. These facilities support multidisciplinary education while encouraging students and researchers to develop practical solutions to real-world engineering and societal challenges.

Kalinga University also promotes entrepreneurship and startup culture by encouraging innovation competitions, hackathons, business plan development, incubation activities, startup mentoring, and industry interactions. Through skill development programmes, entrepreneurship awareness initiatives, and technology-based projects, students are motivated to become innovators, entrepreneurs, and job creators rather than merely job seekers.

The University further contributes to sustainable industrialization by promoting research in clean energy technologies, resource-efficient manufacturing, sustainable construction materials, circular economy practices, waste management, water conservation, smart agriculture, and environmentally responsible engineering solutions. These initiatives support regional and national development while contributing towards resilient infrastructure and sustainable industrial growth.

By integrating advanced research, innovation, industry collaboration, entrepreneurship, technology transfer, and modern infrastructure into its academic ecosystem, Kalinga University significantly contributes towards achieving United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 9—Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure, fostering technological excellence and sustainable development for the benefit of society and the nation.

sections.title: 9.1 Research on industry, innovation and infrastructure

blocks.text: Kalinga University, Raipur, has established a strong research ecosystem that promotes industry-oriented research, technological innovation, infrastructure development, and interdisciplinary collaboration, directly contributing to United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 9 (Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure). The University encourages faculty members, researchers, and students to undertake applied research that addresses industrial challenges while supporting sustainable technological development and regional economic growth.

The University has developed a dedicated Research and Innovation Cell to promote high-quality research, consultancy, technology development, intellectual property generation, and collaborative projects with industries, research organizations, and academic institutions. Research activities are guided by well-defined policies on research integrity, consultancy, intellectual property rights (IPR), seed funding, ethics, and innovation, thereby creating a conducive environment for scientific advancement.

To support advanced research, Kalinga University has established more than 100 modern laboratories equipped with state-of-the-art instrumentation. The University's Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) provides sophisticated analytical equipment including Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM), X-Ray Diffractometer (XRD), FTIR Spectrometer, High Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC), Bio-Chemistry Analyzer, 3D Printer, Digital Viscometer, and other advanced research instruments. These facilities enable multidisciplinary research in engineering, material science, biotechnology, environmental science, healthcare, agriculture, and applied sciences.

Recognizing the importance of industry-academia collaboration, Kalinga University has established seven Centres of Excellence (CoEs) in partnership with leading industrial organizations. These Centres provide industry-focused education, skill development, product design, prototype development, and applied research in emerging technologies. The Centres include:
Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Training Centre
Electric Vehicles Training Centre
Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) Training Centre
Robotics, Coding and Drone Technology Centre
Automobile Training Centre
MSME Training Centre
BRIDGE Skill Development Centre
These Centres strengthen students' practical competencies while facilitating collaborative research and technology transfer in high-growth industrial sectors.

The University actively promotes innovation and entrepreneurship through its IPR Cell and Incubation Cell, which assist faculty members, researchers, and students in patent filing, intellectual property protection, prototype development, startup incubation, technology commercialization, and industry networking. The incubation ecosystem encourages innovative solutions for societal and industrial challenges while supporting startup creation and entrepreneurship development.

Kalinga University also maintains extensive collaborations with industries, government agencies, research organizations, and international universities through various Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs). These collaborations facilitate joint research projects, consultancy assignments, internships, industrial training, technology transfer, expert lectures, faculty exchange, and curriculum development. Such partnerships ensure that research activities remain aligned with industrial needs and national priorities.

The University encourages interdisciplinary research addressing national and global challenges in areas such as renewable energy, electric mobility, artificial intelligence, Industry 4.0, smart manufacturing, advanced materials, environmental sustainability, healthcare technologies, agriculture, water resource management, and digital transformation. Faculty members and research scholars are actively involved in externally funded research projects, consultancy assignments, patent development, and technology-based innovations that contribute to sustainable industrial development.

Through continuous investment in research infrastructure, promotion of innovation, strengthening of industry partnerships, development of advanced laboratories, and encouragement of entrepreneurship, Kalinga University has created a robust research ecosystem that supports sustainable industrialization and technological advancement. These initiatives demonstrate the University's strong commitment towards achieving SDG 9: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure, while contributing to regional development, national innovation capacity, and global scientific progress.

Kalinga University has demonstrated significant growth in research aligned with SDG 9 (Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure), with publications increasing from 3 in 2021 to 159 in 2025. blocks.text: 9.1.1 Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure: Publications
Overview

Research publications are one of the most significant indicators of a university's contribution towards Sustainable Development Goal 9 (SDG 9): Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure. Scientific publications disseminate new knowledge, promote technological advancement, strengthen industrial competitiveness, and provide innovative solutions to societal and engineering challenges. Universities that produce high-quality research publications contribute significantly to sustainable industrialization, infrastructure development, digital transformation, and innovation-driven economic growth.

Kalinga University, Raipur, has established a vibrant research culture that encourages faculty members, researchers, and students to publish high-quality research in reputed national and international journals, conference proceedings, books, and book chapters. The University provides institutional support through its Research and Innovation Cell, Research Development Cell (RDC), Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Cell, and Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF), enabling researchers to undertake multidisciplinary and industry-oriented research.
The University's research publications encompass several disciplines directly aligned with SDG 9, including:
Advanced Manufacturing and Smart Manufacturing
Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
Industry 4.0 and Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT)
Robotics and Automation
Renewable and Sustainable Energy
Electric Vehicles and Green Mobility
Civil and Smart Infrastructure
Construction Materials and Structural Engineering
Environmental Engineering
Water Resources and Sustainable Technologies
Computer Science and Digital Technologies
Advanced Materials and Nanotechnology
Mechanical Design and Thermal Engineering
Biotechnology and Industrial Applications

Faculty members regularly publish research articles in Scopus-indexed, Web of Science, SCI, and UGC-CARE listed journals, thereby enhancing the University's national and international research visibility. Researchers also present their work in prestigious national and international conferences, promoting academic collaboration and technology dissemination.

The University actively motivates faculty members and research scholars to undertake interdisciplinary and collaborative research addressing real-world industrial problems. Research outcomes are frequently aligned with national flagship initiatives such as Make in India, Digital India, Startup India, Atmanirbhar Bharat, National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, and the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

To further strengthen research productivity, Kalinga University organizes International Conferences, Faculty Development Programmes (FDPs), Workshops, Research Methodology Programmes, Patent Awareness Programmes, and Industry-Academia Interaction Sessions. These initiatives enhance research capacity, encourage scientific writing, improve publication quality, and foster collaborations with industries and research institutions.

Kalinga University, Raipur recognizes the critical role of research, innovation, and technology transfer in fostering sustainable industrialization and strengthening regional innovation ecosystems. The University actively promotes an innovation-driven culture by encouraging faculty members, researchers, and students to develop novel technologies, processes, and products that can be protected through intellectual property rights (IPRs). Patents emerging from university research demonstrate Kalinga University's commitment to transforming scientific discoveries into practical, industry-oriented solutions with societal and economic impact.
University-Linked Patent Activity

Kalinga University has generated several patents and patent applications across diverse fields of engineering, renewable energy, healthcare, agriculture, information technology, and environmental sustainability. These innovations reflect the University's focus on addressing contemporary industrial challenges while supporting the goals of sustainable development. The University's patent portfolio highlights the successful translation of academic research into protectable intellectual assets with potential for commercialization and industrial application.
Impact on Industrial Relevance and Technological Capacity
Kalinga University's patent ecosystem contributes significantly to industrial development and technological advancement in the following ways:
Translation of Research into Industrial Technologies:

The University's patented innovations in renewable energy systems, advanced manufacturing, healthcare technologies, artificial intelligence, smart agriculture, environmental engineering, and sustainable materials demonstrate the successful conversion of academic research into technologies with commercial and industrial potential. These innovations facilitate technology transfer, product development, and industrial collaboration.
Regional Relevance and Sustainable Development:

Many of the University's innovations are designed to address regional and national challenges, including clean energy generation, water resource management, agricultural productivity, waste utilization, environmental protection, smart infrastructure, and affordable healthcare. These technologies contribute to sustainable industrialization while supporting local economic development and improving community well-being.
Strengthening Innovation Capacity:

Kalinga University continuously promotes a culture of innovation through regular Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) awareness programmes, patent drafting workshops, innovation boot camps, hackathons, faculty development programmes, and entrepreneurship initiatives. These activities enhance the capacity of researchers and students to generate high-quality innovations, resulting in an increasing number of patent filings and technology-oriented research outcomes.
Institutional Support for Innovation

Kalinga University has established a dedicated Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Cell and an Innovation and Incubation Centre to facilitate the protection, management, and commercialization of intellectual property generated by the University. The institution provides comprehensive support for patent searching, patent drafting, filing, prosecution, and technology transfer. Faculty members and students are encouraged through institutional incentives, research grants, incubation support, industry collaborations, and innovation competitions to pursue patentable research and entrepreneurial ventures.

The University also actively organizes World Intellectual Property Day, National Innovation Day, expert lectures, IPR awareness workshops, startup mentoring programmes, and industry interaction sessions to strengthen the innovation ecosystem. These initiatives create an enabling environment for translating research outcomes into commercially viable technologies, thereby enhancing Kalinga University's contribution to industrial development, technological advancement, and sustainable economic growth in alignment with SDG 9 – Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure

blocks.text: 9.2.1 Number of Patents Citing Research
Overview

Kalinga University, Raipur, actively promotes innovation, intellectual property creation, technology transfer, and commercialization of research through its well-established research ecosystem. The University has instituted dedicated mechanisms such as the Research and Innovation Cell, Research Development Cell (RDC), Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Cell, and Incubation and Innovation Centre to encourage faculty members, researchers, and students to convert innovative research into intellectual property and commercially viable technologies.

The University has developed a comprehensive Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Policy that supports patent identification, patent drafting, filing, prosecution, and commercialization. Regular workshops, seminars, awareness programmes, and expert lectures are organized to educate researchers about intellectual property protection, technology transfer, licensing opportunities, and startup development.

As reported by the University, more than 549 patents have been filed and published by faculty members, researchers, and innovators across diverse disciplines including engineering, renewable energy, healthcare technologies, artificial intelligence, agriculture, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, environmental science, and advanced materials. These patents reflect the University's commitment to promoting innovation-driven research with industrial relevance.
Research conducted at Kalinga University addresses several emerging areas directly contributing to sustainable industrial development, including:
Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
Electric Vehicles and Sustainable Mobility
Renewable Energy Systems
Smart Manufacturing and Industry 4.0
Internet of Things (IoT)
Advanced Materials and Nanotechnology
Water Treatment Technologies
Healthcare Technologies
Agricultural Engineering
Environmental Sustainability
Mechanical System Design and Automation

The University encourages interdisciplinary research that has the potential to generate patentable technologies and innovative industrial solutions. Faculty members collaborate with industries, government organizations, startups, and research institutions to develop technologies that address real-world engineering and societal challenges.

Kalinga University also promotes technology commercialization and entrepreneurship by supporting prototype development, proof-of-concept studies, startup incubation, industry collaborations, consultancy services, and technology licensing. These initiatives enhance the likelihood of research outcomes being adopted by industry and subsequently cited in patent literature.

Although the specific number of global patents citing Kalinga University's research publications is determined through international patent databases such as those maintained by the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO), European Patent Office (EPO), United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO), and other national patent offices, the University's growing research output, increasing number of patents, and industry-oriented innovations significantly enhance its contribution to technology development and industrial innovation.

With continuous investment in research infrastructure, intellectual property development, industry collaboration, and innovation ecosystems, Kalinga University is strengthening the societal and industrial impact of its research. These efforts directly support Sustainable Development Goal 9 (Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure) by fostering innovation, promoting technology transfer, and contributing to sustainable industrialization.

blocks.text: Overview

Kalinga University, Raipur, promotes innovation, entrepreneurship, and technology commercialization by encouraging faculty members, researchers, and students to transform research outcomes into commercially viable products, technologies, and startups. Through its Innovation and Incubation Centre, Research and Innovation Cell, and Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Cell, the University provides mentorship, incubation support, intellectual property assistance, industry networking, and entrepreneurship training to foster innovation-driven enterprises.

The University actively supports the development of startups and entrepreneurial ventures in areas such as engineering, information technology, agriculture, healthcare, renewable energy, and sustainable technologies. These initiatives encourage researchers to translate innovative ideas into market-ready solutions, contributing to industrial growth, employment generation, and regional economic development. By strengthening its startup ecosystem and promoting research-based entrepreneurship, Kalinga University advances SDG 9: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure.

blocks.text: 9.3.1 Number of University Spin-offs
Overview

Kalinga University, Raipur, promotes the commercialization of research through innovation, entrepreneurship, and technology transfer. The University encourages faculty members, researchers, and students to transform intellectual property (IP), patented technologies, and research outcomes into commercially viable enterprises. Through its Innovation and Incubation Centre, Research and Innovation Cell, and IPR Cell, the University provides incubation support, mentoring, business development assistance, and industry linkages to facilitate the creation of technology-based startups and spin-off companies.

The University supports the development of enterprises based on innovative research in engineering, information technology, biotechnology, agriculture, healthcare, renewable energy, and other emerging technologies. These initiatives strengthen the innovation ecosystem and contribute to sustainable industrial development in line with SDG 9: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure.

sections.title: 9.4 Research Income from Industry and Commerce

blocks.text: Overview

Kalinga University, Raipur, actively promotes industry-sponsored research, consultancy, collaborative projects, and technology development through partnerships with industries, government organizations, and research institutions. The University encourages faculty members to undertake applied research addressing industrial challenges, thereby generating research funding and strengthening academia–industry collaboration.

Through its Research and Innovation Cell, Research Development Cell (RDC), Corporate Resource Centre (CRC), and collaborations with industrial partners, Kalinga University undertakes research in areas such as advanced manufacturing, artificial intelligence, renewable energy, electric vehicles, sustainable infrastructure, agriculture, healthcare, environmental technologies, and digital transformation. These partnerships facilitate sponsored research projects, consultancy assignments, laboratory development, technology transfer, and skill development initiatives.

The University continuously strives to enhance research income from industry and commerce by strengthening collaborations, promoting interdisciplinary research, establishing Centres of Excellence, and encouraging innovation-driven projects that address the needs of industry and society. These initiatives contribute directly to SDG 9: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure.

Overview

Kalinga University, Raipur, actively promotes industry-sponsored research by encouraging faculty members to undertake collaborative research, consultancy projects, and technology development in partnership with industries, government agencies, and research organizations. Through its Research and Innovation Cell (RIC), Research Development Cell (RDC), Corporate Resource Centre (CRC), and various Centres of Excellence (CoEs), the University facilitates research funding from industrial and commercial organizations across STEM, healthcare, agriculture, management, and social science disciplines.

Research funding received from industry supports applied research, prototype development, testing and consultancy services, technology transfer, laboratory modernization, and skill development. These collaborations strengthen academia–industry linkages while enhancing the University's contribution to innovation, sustainable industrial development, and knowledge creation in alignment with SDG 9: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure.
